statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of rapid heart rate
There is clinical suspicion for supraventricular tachycardia
Mobile cardiac telemetry monitoring (CPT 93229) is ordered
The service is for continuous rhythm monitoring
The service is to accurately capture the arrhythmia during symptomatic events
The service is to guide further management
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
